zh: 『你是说，你的话不能告诉我师父，师娘？』『对了。』『好！我起誓∶如果阿巧姐对我说的话，我告诉了我师父师娘，叫我天打雷劈。』阿巧姐点头表示满意；然后说道∶『你师娘真叫「又做师娘又做鬼」——。』用这句苟刻的批评开头，阿巧且将七姑奶奶几次劝她的话『夹叙夹议』地从头细诉，照她的看法，完全是七姑奶奶有意要拆散她跟胡雪岩的姻缘，七姑奶奶劝她委屈，入门见礼正正式式做胡家的偏房，看似好意，其实是虚情，因为明知也决不愿这么做，就尽不妨这么说，好逼得不能不下堂求去。
en: “You mean I must not tell my master or his wife what you say?” “Exactly.” “Very well, I swear it: if I tell either of them what A’qiao tells me, may Heaven strike me dead with lightning.” A’qiao nodded, satisfied. “Your master’s wife really does play both the spirit-medium and the ghost—” Beginning with this harsh judgment, she recounted in detail the several occasions on which the Seventh Lady had advised her, interweaving the conversations with comments of her own. In her view, the Seventh Lady had deliberately set out to break her bond with Hu. Her advice that A’qiao swallow her pride, enter the household, make the proper obeisances, and formally become Hu’s concubine only appeared well meant. It was false kindness. Knowing perfectly well that A’qiao would never agree, she could safely urge it upon her and thereby force her to ask to leave.

zh: 对胡雪岩，七姑奶奶在她面前一再说他『滑头』，『没常性，见一个爱一个』；听来是骂胡雪岩而其实是帮他。『萧少爷你想，你这位师娘开口「小爷叔」，闭口』小爷叔『，敬得他来象菩萨。就算他真的「滑头」、「没常性」，又怎好去说他？』阿巧姐说到这里很激动了，「我先倒也当她生来爽直，真的是为我抱不平，所以有啥说啥。后来越想越不对，前前后后，想了又想，才晓得她的意思，无非说胡某人怎么样不是人，犯不着再跟他而已！『听她对七姑奶奶的指责，实在不无道理。但越觉得她有道理，越觉得心里难过；因为萧家骥对他的这位师娘，有如幼弟之于长姐，既敬且爱。多少年来存在心目中的一个伉爽、正直、热心、慷慨的完美印象，此时似乎发现了裂良，怎不教人痛心？因此，他竟没有一句话说。这一方面是感到对阿巧姐安慰，或为七姑奶奶辩护都不甚合适；另一方面也实在是沮丧得什么话都懒得说了。
en: As for Hu, the Seventh Lady had repeatedly called him “slippery,” a man with “no constancy, who falls in love with every woman he sees.” It sounded like abuse of Hu, but in fact it helped him. “Think, Young Master Xiao. Your master’s wife is forever saying ‘Little Uncle’ this and ‘Little Uncle’ that. She reveres him as though he were a bodhisattva. Even if he really were slippery and inconstant, how could she speak of him that way?” A’qiao had grown agitated. “At first I thought she was naturally outspoken and was truly indignant on my behalf, so she said whatever came into her head. Later, the more I thought, the less it seemed right. I went over everything again and again until I understood. All she meant was that Hu was such a scoundrel that he was not worth staying with!” Her accusations against the Seventh Lady were not without reason. Yet the more reasonable they seemed, the more painful Xiao found them. He regarded his master’s wife as a young brother regards an elder sister, with both respect and affection. For years he had cherished a perfect image of her as forthright, honest, warmhearted, and generous. Now he seemed to see a crack in it. How could that not hurt? He could not utter a word. Neither comforting A’qiao nor defending the Seventh Lady seemed quite appropriate; besides, he was too dejected to feel like saying anything at all.

zh: 一见萧家骥的脸色，胡雪岩吓一大跳；他倒象害了一场病似的。何以跟阿巧姐见了一次，有这样的似乎受了极大刺激的神情？令人惊疑莫释，而又苦于不便深问；只问得一句∶『见过面了？』『见过了。我们谢谢了尘师太，告辞吧！』了尘又变得很沉着了，她也不提阿巧姐，只殷勤地请胡雪岩与萧家骥再来『随喜』。居姑庵中何以请男施主来随喜？这话听来便令人有异样之感；只是无暇去分辨她的言外之意。
en: The sight of Xiao’s face gave Hu a shock. He looked as though he had been ill. What could one meeting with A’qiao have done to leave him so visibly shaken? Hu was troubled and bewildered, yet could hardly question him closely here. He merely asked, “Have you seen her?” “Yes. Let us thank Sister Liaochen and take our leave.” Liaochen had recovered her composure. She too said nothing of A’qiao, only warmly invited the two men to return and “share in the religious joys” of the place. Why should men be invited to enjoy religious visits to a convent? The words had an odd sound, but there was no time to consider what lay beneath them.

zh: 不过，胡雪岩对人情应酬上的过节，一向不会忽略，想到有件事该做，随即说了出来∶『请问，缘簿在哪里？』『不必客气了！』胡雪岩已经发现，黄色封面的缘簿，就挂在墙壁上，便随手摘下，文给萧家骥说∶『请你写一写，写一百两银子。』『太多了！』了尘接口说道∶「如果说是为了宝眷住在我们这里，要写这么多，那也用不着！出家人受十方供养，也供养十方；不必胡施主费心。『』那是两回事。『萧家骥越出他的范围，代为回答∶』各人尽各人的心意。『接着，萧家骥便用现成的笔砚，写了缘簿；胡雪岩取一张一百两的银两，夹在缘簿中一起放在桌上，随即告辞出庵。回营谢过朱管带，仍旧由原来护送的人送回上海。一路奔驰，无暇交谈，到了闹区，萧家骥才勒住马说道∶『胡先生，到你府上去细谈。』
en: Hu, however, never neglected the niceties of social dealings. Remembering something he ought to do, he asked at once, “Where is the book of donations?” “There is no need for such ceremony.” He had already spotted the yellow-covered book hanging on the wall. Taking it down, he handed it to Xiao. “Please enter a hundred taels for me.” “That is too much!” Liaochen interposed. “If you mean to give so much because your lady is staying here, there is no need. Those who have left the world receive support from all quarters and offer support to all quarters. You need not concern yourself.” “Those are separate matters,” Xiao replied on Hu’s behalf, going beyond his own role. “Each of us does what is in his heart.” He used the brush and ink already laid out to make the entry. Hu put a banknote for a hundred taels inside the book, placed it on the table, and took his leave. They returned to the camp to thank Commander Zhu, then rode back to Shanghai under the same escort. They traveled too fast for conversation. Only when they reached the busy streets did Xiao rein in his horse. “Mr Hu, let us go to your house and talk at length.”

zh: 于是遣走了那名马弁，一起到胡雪岩与阿巧姐双栖之处。粉奁犹香，明镜如昨；但却别有一股凄凉的意味；胡雪岩换了一个地方，在他书房中闭门深浅。听萧家骥转述了阿巧姐的愤慨之词，胡雪岩才知道他为何有那样的痛苦的神态。当然，在胡雪岩也很难过；自他认识七姑奶奶以来，从未听见有人对她有这样严苛的批评，如今为了自己，使她在阿巧姐口中落了个阴险小人的名声，想想实在对不起七姑奶奶。『胡先生，』萧家骥将一路上不断在想的一句话，问了出来∶『我师娘是不是真的象阿巧姐所说的那样，是有意耍手段？』『是的。』胡雪岩点点头，『这是她过于热心之故。阿巧姐的话，大致都对；只有一点她弄错了。你师娘这样做，实实在在是为她打算。』接着胡雪岩便为七姑奶奶解释，她是真正替阿巧姐的终身打算，既然不愿做偏房，不如分手，择人而事。他虽不知道七姑奶奶有意为阿巧姐与张郎中撮合，但他相信，以七姑奶奶的热心待人，一定会替阿巧姐觅个妥当的归宿。
en: They dismissed the mounted orderly and went together to the house Hu had shared with A’qiao. Her powder box still held its fragrance; the bright mirror stood as before. Yet the rooms had taken on a desolate air. Hu chose another room, shutting himself in his study with Xiao for a private conversation. When Xiao repeated A’qiao’s indignant words, Hu understood why he had looked so distressed. He too was deeply troubled. In all the time he had known the Seventh Lady, he had never heard anyone criticize her so harshly. Now, because of him, A’qiao had branded her a treacherous schemer. He felt he had done the Seventh Lady a great wrong. “Mr Hu,” Xiao asked, voicing a question that had occupied him all the way back, “has my master’s wife really been deliberately maneuvering things as A’qiao says?” “Yes.” Hu nodded. “She is too eager to help. Most of what A’qiao says is true. She has misunderstood only one point: your master’s wife is doing it entirely for her sake.” He went on to explain. The Seventh Lady was sincerely considering A’qiao’s lifelong welfare. Since she would not become a concubine, she would do better to part from him and choose another man. Hu did not know that the Seventh Lady intended to match her with Dr Zhang, but he believed that, with her warm concern for others, she would certainly find A’qiao a suitable home.

zh: 这番解释，萧家骥完全能够接受；甚至可以说，他所希望的，就是这样一番能为七姑奶奶洗刷恶名的解释。因此神态顿时不同；轻快欣慰，仿佛卸下了肩上的重担似的。『原说呢，我师娘怎么会做这种事？她如果听说阿巧姐是这样深的误会，不知道要气成什么样子？』『对了！』胡雪岩矍然惊觉∶『阿巧姐的话，绝对不能跟她说。』『不说又怎么交代？』于是两个人商量如何搪塞七姑奶奶？说没有找到，她会再托阿金去找；说是已经祝发，决不肯再回家，她一定亦不会死心，自己找到白衣庵去碰钉子。想来想去没有妥当的办法。
en: Xiao could accept this explanation completely. Indeed, it was precisely what he had hoped for: an explanation that would clear the Seventh Lady of the charge against her. His manner changed at once. He became cheerful and relieved, as though a heavy burden had slipped from his shoulders. “That is what I thought! How could my master’s wife do such a thing? If she heard how deeply A’qiao misunderstood her, there is no knowing how angry she would be.” “Exactly!” Hu suddenly took alarm. “You must on no account tell her what A’qiao said.” “But if we say nothing, how are we to explain?” They discussed how to put the Seventh Lady off. If they said they had not found A’qiao, she would ask A’jin to look again. If they said A’qiao had shaved her head and absolutely refused to return, she would still persist and go to White-Robed Convent herself, only to be rebuffed. However much they thought, they could find no satisfactory answer.

zh: 丢下这层不谈，萧家骥问道∶『胡先生，那末你对阿巧姐，究竟作何打算呢？』这话也使得胡雪岩很难回答；心里转了好半天的念头，付之一叹∶『我只有挨骂了！』『这是说，决定割舍？』『不割舍又如何？』『那就这样，索性置之不理。』萧家骥说∶『心肠要硬就硬到底！』『是我自己良心上的事。』胡雪岩说，『置之不理，似乎也不是办法。』『怎么才是办法？』萧家骥说，『要阿巧姐心甘情愿地分手，是办不到的事。』
en: Leaving that difficulty aside, Xiao asked, “Mr Hu, what do you mean to do about A’qiao?” That too was hard for Hu to answer. He turned it over in his mind for a long time, then sighed. “I can only resign myself to being cursed.” “You mean you have decided to give her up?” “What else can I do?” “Then leave the matter entirely alone,” Xiao said. “If you are to harden your heart, harden it all the way.” “It is a matter of my own conscience,” Hu replied. “Ignoring her altogether hardly seems right.” “What would be right, then? There is no way to make A’qiao agree willingly to the separation.”

zh: 『不求她心甘情愿，只望她咽得下那口气。』胡雪岩作了决定∶『我想这样子办——。』他的办法是一方面用缓兵之计，隐住七姑奶奶，只说阿巧姐由白衣庵的当家师太介绍，已远赴他乡，目前正派人追下去劝驾了；一方面要拜托怡情老二转托阿金∶第一、帮着瞒谎，不能在七姑奶奶面前道破真相；第二、请她跟阿巧姐去见一面，转达一句话，不管阿巧姐要干什么，祝发也好，从良也好，乃至于步了尘的后尘也好，胡雪岩都不会干预，而且预备送她一大笔钱。说完了他的打算，胡雪岩自己亦有如释重负之感；因为牵缠多日，终于有了快刀斩乱麻的处置。而在萧家骥，虽并不以为这是一个好办法；只是除此以外，别无善策，而况毕竟事不干己，要想使劲出力也用不上，只有点点头表示赞成。『事不宜迟，你师娘还在等回音；该干什么干什么，今天晚上还要辛苦你。』『胡先生的事就等于我师父的事，』萧家骥想了一下说，『我们先去看怡情老二。』
en: “I do not ask for willing agreement. I only hope she can swallow the bitterness.” Hu made his decision. “This is what I propose—” He would first gain time and keep the Seventh Lady quiet by saying that the abbess of White-Robed Convent had sent A’qiao to another place far away, and that someone was already following to persuade her to return. At the same time, he would ask the Second Miss to enlist A’jin’s help. First, A’jin must support the story and never reveal the truth to the Seventh Lady. Second, she must see A’qiao and deliver a message: whatever A’qiao wished to do—take the tonsure, marry respectably, or even follow in Liaochen’s footsteps—Hu would not interfere. He was also ready to give her a large sum of money. Once he had explained the plan, Hu too felt relieved. After so many days of entanglement, he had at last found a way to cut through it. Xiao did not consider it a good solution, but could think of no better one. Besides, it was not his own affair; however much he wished to help, there was little he could do. He could only nod his agreement. “We must act at once,” Hu said. “Your master’s wife is still waiting for news. Let us do what needs doing. I must trouble you with more work tonight.” “Your business is as much my concern as my master’s.” Xiao thought for a moment. “Let us see the Second Miss first.”

zh: 到了怡情老二那里，灯红酒绿，夜正未央。不过她是『本家』，另有自己的『小房子』；好在相去不远，『相帮』领着，片刻就到。入门之时，正听得客厅里的自鸣钟打十二下；怡情老二虽不曾睡，却已上楼回卧室了。听得小大姐一报，她请客人上楼。端午将近的天气，相当闷热；她穿一件家常绸夹袄对客，袖管很大也很短，露出两弯雪白的膀子，一只手膀上戴一支金镯，一只手腕上戴一支翠镯，丰容盛髻、一副福相；这使得萧家骥又生感触，相形之下，越觉得阿巧姐憔悴可怜。由于胡、萧十分是初次光临，怡情老二少不得有一番周旋，倒茶摆果碟子，还要『开灯』请客人『躺一息』。主要殷勤，客人当然也要故作闲豫，先说些不相干的话，然后谈入正题。
en: At the Second Miss’s establishment, lamps glowed red, wine flowed, and the night was still young. But she was the proprietress and had a separate little house of her own. Fortunately it was nearby; an attendant led them there in a few moments. As they entered, they heard the clock in the sitting room strike twelve. The Second Miss had not gone to sleep, though she had retired upstairs to her bedroom. When her maid announced the visitors, she invited them up. With the Dragon Boat Festival approaching, the weather had grown close and hot. She received them in an informal lined silk jacket whose broad, short sleeves exposed her white forearms. On one arm she wore a gold bracelet, on the other a jade bangle. Her full face and abundant, carefully dressed hair gave her a look of prosperity and good fortune. The sight stirred Xiao again: by comparison, A’qiao seemed all the more worn and pitiable. Since this was the two men’s first visit to her house, the Second Miss had to observe the usual courtesies. She poured tea, set out dishes of fruit, and even offered to light the opium lamp and let them recline for a while. Before such hospitality, the guests too had to make a show of being at leisure. They began with irrelevant conversation before turning to their purpose.

zh: 萧家骥刚说得一句『阿巧姐果然在白衣庵』，小大姐端着托盘进房；于是小酌宵夜，一面继谈此行经过。萧家骥话完；胡雪岩接着开口，拜托怡情老二从中斡旋。一直静听不语的怡情老二，不即置答；事情太离奇了，她竟一时摸不清头绪。眨着眼想了好一会才摇摇头说∶『胡老爷，我看事情不是这么做法。这件事少不得七姑奶奶！』接着，她谈到张郎中；认为七姑奶奶的做法是正办。至于阿巧姐有所误会，无论如何是解释得清楚的。为今之计，只有设法将阿巧姐劝了回来；化解误会，消除怨恨，归嫁张宅，这一切只要大家同心协心花功夫下去，一定可以有圆满的结局。『阿金不必让她插手了；决绝的话，更不可以说。现在阿巧姐的心思想偏了，要耐心拿它慢慢扭过来。七姑奶奶脾气虽毛糙，倒是最肯体恤人、最肯顾大局；阿巧姐的误会，她肯原谅的，也肯委屈的。不过话可以跟她说明白；犯不着让她一白衣庵去碰钉了。我看，胡老爷——。』她有意不再说下去，是希望胡雪岩有所意会，自动作一个表示。而胡雪岩的心思很乱，不耐细想，率直问道∶『二阿姐，你要说啥？』
en: Xiao had barely said, “A’qiao was at White-Robed Convent after all,” when the maid came in with a tray. Over a little wine and a late supper, he continued his account of the visit. When he finished, Hu asked the Second Miss to act as intermediary. She had listened without a word and did not answer at once. The whole affair was so strange that she could scarcely make sense of it. For a while she blinked in thought, then shook her head. “Mr Hu, I do not think that is the way to handle matters. We cannot do without the Seventh Lady in this.” She told him about Dr Zhang and argued that the Seventh Lady’s course was the right one. A’qiao’s misunderstanding could surely be explained away. What they must do now was persuade her to return, clear up the misunderstanding, dispel her resentment, and arrange her marriage into the Zhang household. If everyone worked together patiently, there was every prospect of a happy conclusion. “There is no need to involve A’jin, and you certainly must not send a message that closes every door. A’qiao’s thoughts have taken a wrong turning; we must patiently guide them back. The Seventh Lady may be hasty, but no one is more considerate or more willing to think of everyone’s interests. She will forgive A’qiao’s misunderstanding and put up with some unfairness. We can explain matters to her openly; there is no reason to let her go to the convent and be rebuffed. As I see it, Mr Hu—” She deliberately stopped, hoping that Hu would understand and volunteer the necessary offer. But his mind was in turmoil and he had no patience for subtlety. “What do you mean, Second Sister?”

zh: 『我说，胡老爷，你委屈一点，明天再亲自到白衣庵去一趟，陪个笑脸，说两句好话，拿阿巧姐先劝了回来再说。』这个要求，胡雪岩答应不下。三番两次，牵缠不清，以致于搁下好多正事不能办；他心里实在也厌倦了。如今好不容易有了个快刀斩乱麻的措施，却又不能实行；反转要跟阿巧姐去陪笑脸，说好话，不但有些于心不甘，也怕她以为自己回心转意，觉得少不得她，越发牵缠得紧，岂不是更招麻烦？看他面难色，怡情老二颇为着急说∶『胡老爷，』她说∶『别样见识，我万万不及你们做官的老爷们；只有这件事上，我有把握。为啥呢？女人的心思，只有女人晓得；再说，阿巧姐跟我相处也不止一年，她的性情，我当然摸得透。胡老爷，我说的是好话，你不听会懊悔！』胡雪岩本对怡情老二有些成见，觉得她未免有所袒护，再听她这番话，成见自然加深，所以一时并无表示，只作个沉吟的样了，当作不以为然的答复。
en: “I mean that you should put your pride aside a little. Go to White-Robed Convent again yourself tomorrow, smile, say a few kind words, and first persuade A’qiao to return. We can consider the rest afterward.” Hu could not agree. This repeated and endless entanglement had forced him to neglect a great deal of important business; he was thoroughly weary of it. Now that he had finally found a way to cut himself free, he was to be prevented from using it. Instead, he must smile at A’qiao and speak ingratiatingly. He resented that; worse, he feared she would think he had changed his mind and could not do without her. She would cling to him still more tightly. Would that not merely invite further trouble? Seeing his reluctance, the Second Miss grew anxious. “Mr Hu, in every other kind of judgment I am far below gentlemen in official life such as yourself. But on this matter I am confident. Why? Because only a woman understands a woman’s thoughts. Besides, A’qiao and I lived together for more than a year. Naturally I know her disposition. I am giving you good advice. If you refuse it, you will regret it.” Hu already suspected the Second Miss of being partial to A’qiao, and her words only strengthened his prejudice. He made no commitment, merely adopting a thoughtful expression to indicate his disagreement.

zh: 萧家骥旁观者清，一方面觉得怡情老二的话虽说得率直了些，而做法是高明的；另一方面又知道胡雪岩的心境，这时不便固劝，越劝越坏。好在巧姐的下落明了，在白衣庵多住些日子亦不要紧。为了避免造成僵局，只有照『事缓则圆』这句话去做。『胡先生也有胡先生的难处；不过你的宗旨是对的！』他加重了语气，同时对怡情老二使个眼色，『慢慢来，迟早要拿事情办通的。』『也好。请萧少爷劝劝胡老爷！』『我知道，我知道。』萧家骥连声答应，『明天我给你回话。今天不早了，走吧！』
en: As an onlooker, Xiao could see more clearly. The Second Miss had spoken rather bluntly, but her approach was sound. Yet he also understood Hu’s state of mind: pressing him now would only make things worse. Fortunately, they knew where A’qiao was, and there was no harm in her remaining at the convent a little longer. To avoid a deadlock, they must follow the maxim that matters settle more smoothly when given time. “Mr Hu has his own difficulties. But your intention is right.” Xiao emphasized the words and gave the Second Miss a meaningful look. “Let us take things slowly. Sooner or later we shall find a way through.” “Very well. Please try to persuade him, Young Master Xiao.” “I will, I will,” Xiao promised repeatedly. “I shall bring you an answer tomorrow. It is late now. We should be going.”

zh: 辞别出门，胡雪岩步履蹒跚，真有心力交瘁之感。萧家骥当然亦不便多说，只问一句∶『胡先生，你今在歇在哪里？我送你去。』『我到钱庄里去睡。』胡雪岩说道∶『你今天还要不要去见你师娘。』『今天就不必去了。这么晚！』『好的。』。胡雪岩沉吟了一会，皱眉摇头，显得不胜其烦似的，『等一两天再说吧！我真的脑筋都笨了，从来没有见过这种拉拉扯扯，弄不清爽的麻烦！『』那末，『萧家骥低声下气地，倒像自己惹上了麻烦，向人求教那样∶』明天见了我师娘，我应当怎么说？『这一次胡雪岩答得非常爽脆∶』只要不伤你师娘的心，怎么说都可以。『回到钱庄，只为心里懊恼，胡雪岩在床上辗转反侧，直到市声渐起，方始朦胧睡去。
en: They took their leave. Hu walked unsteadily, utterly exhausted in body and mind. Xiao could hardly add anything; he only asked, “Where will you sleep tonight, Mr Hu? I shall see you there.” “At the bank. Will you still go to your master’s wife tonight?” “There is no need now. It is so late.” “Very well.” Hu pondered a moment, then frowned and shook his head, looking unbearably harassed. “Let us leave it for a day or two. My mind has truly gone dull. I have never known such a tangle of trouble, with everyone pulling at everyone else and nothing ever settled.” “Then,” Xiao asked in a subdued voice, almost as though he himself had caused the trouble and was begging for advice, “what should I say when I see my master’s wife tomorrow?” This time Hu answered promptly and decisively. “Say anything you like, provided you do not hurt her.” Back at the bank, his vexation kept him tossing in bed. Only as the sounds of the city began to rise did he drift into an uneasy sleep.

zh: 正好梦方酣之时，突然被人推醒；睁开涩重的睡眼，只见萧家骥笑嘻嘻地站在床前，『胡先生，』他说，『宝眷都到了！』胡雪岩睡意全消，一骨碌地翻身而起，一面掀被，一面问道∶『在哪里？』『先到我师娘那里，一番皇历，恰好是宜于进屋的好日子，决定此刻就回新居。师娘着我来通知胡先生。』于是胡家母子夫妇父女相聚，恍如隔世，全家大小，呜咽不止；还有七姑奶奶在一旁陪着掉泪。好不容易一个个止住了哭声，细叙别后光景，谈到悲痛之处，少不得又淌眼泪；就这样谈了哭、哭了谈；一直到第三天上，胡老太太与胡雪岩的情绪，才算稳定下来。这三天之中，最忙的自然是七姑奶奶；胡家初到上海，一切陌生，处处要她指点照料。
en: He was deep in a dream when someone suddenly shook him awake. Opening his heavy, sore eyes, he saw Xiao standing beside the bed with a broad smile. “Mr Hu, your family has arrived!” All sleep vanished. Hu sprang up, throwing back the quilt. “Where are they?” “They went first to my master’s wife. She checked the almanac and found that today is an auspicious day for moving into a house, so they decided to go straight to the new home. She sent me to tell you.” Mother and son, husband and wife, father and daughter were reunited as though after a lifetime apart. Everyone in the Hu household sobbed, and the Seventh Lady wept beside them. At last, one by one, they stopped crying and began to describe what had happened since their separation. At every painful recollection the tears started again. Thus they talked and wept, wept and talked; not until the third day did Hu and his mother begin to regain their composure. During those three days, the busiest person was naturally the Seventh Lady. Newly arrived in Shanghai, the Hu family found everything unfamiliar and depended upon her guidance and care at every turn.

zh: 但是只要稍微静了下来，她就会想到阿巧姐；中年弃妇，栖身尼寺，设身处地为她想一想，不知生趣何在？因此，她不时会自惊∶不要阿巧姐寻了短见了？这种不安，与日俱增；不能不找刘不才去商量了。『不要紧！』刘不才答说，『我跟萧家骥去一趟，看情形再说。』于是找到萧家骥，轻车熟路，到了白庆庵；一叩禅关，来应门的仍旧是小音。『喔，萧施主，』小音还认得他，『阿巧姐到了宁波去了！』这个消息太突兀了，『她到宁波去做什么？』萧家骥问。『我师父会告诉你。小音答说，』我师父说过，萧施主一定还会来，果然不错。请进，请进。『于是两人被延入萧家骥上次到过的那座精舍中；坐不到一盏茶的工夫，了尘飘然出现，刘不才眼睛一亮，不由得含笑起立。
en: Yet whenever there was a quiet moment, she thought of A’qiao: a woman forsaken in middle age, taking refuge in a convent. Putting herself in A’qiao’s place, she could see little joy left in life. From time to time an alarming thought struck her: what if A’qiao took her own life? Her anxiety increased each day until she had to consult Liu Bucai. “Do not worry,” he replied. “I shall go there with Xiao Jiaji, and we shall see how matters stand.” He found Xiao, and they set out for White-Robed Convent along the now familiar route. When they knocked at its gate, Xiaoyin again answered. “Oh, Mr Xiao!” She still recognized him. “A’qiao has gone to Ningbo.” The news was entirely unexpected. “What has she gone to Ningbo for?” Xiao asked. “My teacher will tell you. She said you would certainly come again, and she was right. Please come in.” She conducted them to the elegant retreat Xiao had visited before. They had scarcely sat long enough to drink a cup of tea when Liaochen appeared with a graceful step. Liu’s eyes brightened, and he rose involuntarily with a smile.

zh: 『了尘师太，』萧家骥为刘不才介绍，『这位姓刘，是胡家的长亲。』『喔，请坐！』了尘开门见山地说，『两位想必是来劝阿巧姐回去的。』『是的。听小师太说，她到宁波去了？可有这话？』『前天走的。去觅归宿去了。』萧家骥大为惊喜，『了尘师太，』他问，『关于阿巧姐的身世，想来完全知道？』『不错！就因为知道了她的身世，我才劝她到宁波去的。』『原来是了尘师太的法力无边，劝得她回了头！』刘不才合十在胸，闭着眼喃喃说道∶『大功德，大功德！』模样有点滑稽，了尘不由得抿嘴一笑；对刘不才仿佛很感兴味似的。
en: “Sister Liaochen,” Xiao said by way of introduction, “this is Mr Liu, a senior relation of the Hu family.” “Ah, please sit. I suppose you have come to persuade A’qiao to return?” “Yes. The young sister tells us she has gone to Ningbo. Is that true?” “She left the day before yesterday—to seek a settled home.” Xiao was delighted and surprised. “Then I presume you know all about A’qiao’s life?” “I do. It was precisely because I knew her story that I urged her to go to Ningbo.” “So it was your boundless spiritual power that persuaded her to turn back!” Liu brought his palms together, closed his eyes, and murmured, “A great deed of merit, a great deed of merit.” He looked rather comical. Liaochen could not help smiling behind pursed lips and seemed to find him distinctly interesting.

zh: 『的确是一场大功德！』萧家骥问道∶『了尘师太开示她的话，能不能告诉我们听听？』『无非拿「因缘」二字来打动她。我劝她，跟胡施主的缘分尽了，不必强求。当初种那个因，如今结这个果，是一定的。至于张郎中那面，种了新因，依旧会结果；此生不结，来世再结。尘世轮回，就是这样一番不断的因果；倒不如今世了掉这番因缘，来世没有宿业，就不会受苦，才是大彻大悟的大智慧人。』了尘接着又说∶『在我养静的地方，对榻而谈，整整劝了她三天，毕竟把她劝醒了！』『了不起！了不起！苦海无边，回头是岸！』刘不才说。『不是大智慧人遇着大智慧人，不会有这场圆满的功德。』『刘施主倒真是辩才无碍。』了尘微笑着说，眼睛一瞟，低头无缘无故地微微笑着。
en: “It is indeed a great deed of merit,” Xiao said. “May we hear the instruction with which you persuaded her?” “I moved her simply by speaking of causes and affinities. I told her that her bond with Mr Hu had run its course and must not be forced. Having sown that cause in the beginning, she must now reap this result. With Dr Zhang, however, she has sown a new cause, and that too must bear fruit. If it does not ripen in this life, it will do so in the next. Our passage through worldly lives is nothing but this endless chain of cause and effect. Better to complete this bond in the present life; with no old karmic debt carried into the next, she need not suffer. That is the course of a person of great wisdom and complete understanding.” Liaochen continued, “We talked from facing couches in my quiet retreat. For three whole days I reasoned with her, until at last she woke to the truth.” “Wonderful! Wonderful!” Liu exclaimed. “The sea of suffering is boundless, but turn your head and there is the shore. Only when one person of great wisdom meets another can such perfect merit be achieved.” “Mr Liu truly has the gift of unhindered eloquence.” Liaochen smiled, cast him a glance, then lowered her head and smiled faintly again for no apparent reason.

zh: 『了尘师太太夸奖我了。不过，佛经我亦稍稍涉猎过，几时得求了尘师太好好开示。』『刘施主果真向善心虔，随时请过来。』『一定要来，一定要来！』刘不才张目四顾，不胜欣赏地，『这样的洞天福地，得与师太对榻参禅；这份清福真不知几时修到？』了尘仍是报以矜持的微笑；萧家骥怕刘不才还要噜苏，赶紧抢着开口∶『请问了尘师父，阿巧姐去了还回不回来？』『不回来了！』『那末她的行李呢？也都带到了宁波？』『不！她一个人先去。张郎中随后会派人来取。』『张郎中派的人来了，能不能请了尘师太带句话给他，务必到阜康钱庄来一趟。』『不必了！』了尘答说∶『一了百了，请萧施主回去，也转告胡施主，缘分已尽，不必再自寻烦恼了。』『善哉！善哉！』刘不才高声念道∶『「欲除烦恼须无我，各有因缘莫羡人！」』
en: “You praise me too highly, Sister Liaochen. Still, I have dipped into the Buddhist scriptures myself. One day I must seek proper instruction from you.” “If you truly desire goodness and are sincere in your devotion, come whenever you wish.” “I certainly shall, certainly!” Liu looked about him with open admiration. “To discuss meditation with you on facing couches in such a blessed retreat—who knows how many lifetimes of merit it would take to earn such pure enjoyment?” Liaochen answered with another reserved smile. Afraid Liu would go on indefinitely, Xiao quickly intervened. “May I ask, Sister Liaochen: will A’qiao return?” “No.” “Then what of her luggage? Has she taken it all to Ningbo?” “No. She went ahead alone. Dr Zhang will send someone for it later.” “When his man comes, could you ask him to be sure to call at Fukang Bank?” “There is no need,” Liaochen replied. “Once it is ended, let everything end. Please tell Mr Hu when you return that the bond has run its course. He need not go on seeking troubles for himself.” “Excellent! Excellent!” Liu intoned loudly. “‘To rid yourself of trouble, let the self be gone; each has his own affinities—envy no one else.’”

zh: 见此光景，萧骥心里不免来气；刘不才简直是在开搅。一赌气之下，别的话也不问了，起身说道∶『多谢了尘师父，我们告辞了。』刘不才犹有恋恋不舍之意，萧家骥不由分说，拉了他就走。一回到家，细说经过，古应春夫妇喜出望外；不过七姑奶奶犹有怏怏不乐之意，『欠还应该问详细点！』好略有怨言。这一下正好触动萧家骥的怨气，『师娘，』他指着刘不才说，『刘三爷跟了尘眉来眼去吊膀子，哪里有我开口的份？』接着将刘不才的语言动作，描画了一遍。古应春夫妇大笑；七姑奶奶更是连眼泪都笑了出来。刘不才等他们笑停了说∶『现在该我说话了吧？』『说，说！』七姑奶奶笑着答应，『刘三叔，你说。』『家骥沉不住气，这有啥好急的？明天我要跟了尘去「参禅」，有多少话不好问她？』
en: Xiao could not help growing angry. Liu was simply making mischief. In a fit of annoyance he abandoned his remaining questions and stood. “Thank you, Sister Liaochen. We shall take our leave.” Liu still seemed reluctant to go, but Xiao allowed no discussion and pulled him away. Back at home, he gave a full account of their visit. Gu Yingchun and his wife were delighted beyond expectation, though the Seventh Lady remained somewhat dissatisfied. “You ought to have asked for more details,” she complained mildly. This touched Xiao’s own grievance exactly. “How could I get a word in?” he asked, pointing at Liu. “Third Master Liu was busy making eyes and flirting with Liaochen!” He proceeded to imitate Liu’s words and gestures. Gu and the Seventh Lady burst out laughing; she laughed until tears came. Liu waited for them to stop. “May I speak now?” “Speak, speak!” the Seventh Lady said, still laughing. “Go ahead, Third Uncle Liu.” “Jiaji cannot keep his patience. What is there to be so anxious about? Tomorrow I shall go and ‘discuss meditation’ with Liaochen. What is there that I cannot ask her then?”

zh: 『对啊！刘三叔，请你问问她，越详细越好。』古应春当时不曾开口；过后对刘不才说∶『你的话不错，「欲除烦恼须无我，各有因缘莫羡人」。小爷叔跟阿巧姐这段孽缘，能够有这样一个结果，真正好极！不必再多事了。刘三叔，我还劝你一句，不要去参什么禅！』『我原是说说好玩的。』
en: “Exactly! Third Uncle Liu, please do ask her—the more detail the better.” Gu said nothing at the time, but afterward spoke privately to Liu. “Your words were right: ‘To rid yourself of trouble, let the self be gone; each has his own affinities—envy no one else.’ For Little Uncle’s unhappy bond with A’qiao to end in this way is an excellent outcome. There is no need to stir matters up again. And let me give you a word of advice, Third Uncle: do not go there to discuss any meditation.” “I was only joking.”
